title: Strict henselization preserves embedding dimension
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m,\kappa)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local commutative ring and let $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ be its strict henselization with respect to a separable closure $\kappa^{\mathrm{sep}}$ of $\kappa$. Write $\mathfrak m^{\mathrm{sh}}$ for the maximal ideal of $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$. Then the canonical base-change map $(\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2)\otimes_{\kappa}\kappa^{\mathrm{sep}}\to\mathfrak m^{\mathrm{sh}}/(\mathfrak m^{\mathrm{sh}})^2$ is an isomorphism of $\kappa^{\mathrm{sep}}$-vector spaces. In particular, $\dim_{\kappa}(\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2)=\dim_{\kappa^{\mathrm{sep}}}(\mathfrak m^{\mathrm{sh}}/(\mathfrak m^{\mathrm{sh}})^2)$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LN (lemma-henselization-regular), proof: minimal generators remain minimal after faithfully flat henselization; Tag 07QM, parts (1)-(2)

proof.text: Use the strict-henselization triples description [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples] with $\mathfrak p=\mathfrak m$ and $K=\kappa^{\mathrm{sep}}$. It identifies $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ with the colimit ring $C$, whose maximal ideal is $\mathfrak m_C=\mathfrak mR^{\mathrm{sh}}$, and identifies its residue field with $\kappa^{\mathrm{sep}}$. The canonical map $R\to R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ is flat by faithful flatness [lem-sc-strict-henselization-faithfully-flat].

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LN (lemma-henselization-regular), proof: use the strict henselization map and Tag 07QM part (1); algebra.tex Tags 04GW and 04GP for the maximal ideal and residue field

proof.text: Apply the conormal flat-base-change isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-cotangent-flat-base-change-ring] to the flat map $R\to R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ and the ideal $\mathfrak m$. Since the extended ideal is $\mathfrak mR^{\mathrm{sh}}=\mathfrak m^{\mathrm{sh}}$ by Step 1, it gives a canonical $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$-linear isomorphism $(\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2)\otimes_R R^{\mathrm{sh}}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathfrak m^{\mathrm{sh}}/(\mathfrak m^{\mathrm{sh}})^2$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0473 (morphisms-lemma-conormal-functorial-flat), affine conormal calculation, specialized to the maximal ideal and strict henselization

proof.text: The $R$-action on $\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2$ factors through $R/\mathfrak m=\kappa$, while the $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$-action on the target factors through $R^{\mathrm{sh}}/\mathfrak m^{\mathrm{sh}}=\kappa^{\mathrm{sep}}$ by Step 1. Therefore the isomorphism of Step 2 is canonically the displayed base-change map $(\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2)\otimes_{\kappa}\kappa^{\mathrm{sep}}\to\mathfrak m^{\mathrm{sh}}/(\mathfrak m^{\mathrm{sh}})^2$. A vector-space isomorphism preserves dimension, giving the final equality.
